claim_text: In The Patriots, Yinon Magal introduced protest footage with 'Look what they're shouting on the left' while the segment rendered the chant as 'לא לממשלה של בבונים' ('No to a government of baboons').
discovery_sources: The Seventh Eye structured monitoring report; Kenes Media contemporaneous report of Kan/Guy Zohar fact-check
resolution_notes: The actual chant was 'לא לממשלה של טייקונים' ('No to a government of tycoons'). The verdict is narrowly False and is limited to the misheard/misrendered chant. Presenter origin is preserved; the on-screen wording reinforced the same rendering. Canonical Sheet claim/sources and Notion card were written and post-write verified.
